TermsOfServiceContent1: When you register for the Ireland State Savings Online service, we will verify your identity as part of the process. It involves taking a photograph of yourself (selfie) and photographing your passport or EU/UK driving licence to verify your identity. We will never use the copy of your identification document or your selfie for anything other than verifying your identity for the purpose of registering for the Ireland State Savings Online service. Registering for this service is entirely voluntary and you may still use Ireland State Savings without signing up to Ireland State Savings Online. By clicking “Next”, you agree you have (1) read, understand, and accept the Ireland State Savings Online Terms and Conditions, (2) had the opportunity to review the type of information collected, the use and processing of the information collected, and the retention of the information as set out in the Ireland State Savings Data Protection Statement.
